data.name: Jilan
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Jilan is derived from the word jalana, which means 'to be gentle' or 'to be kind'. The name is also associated with trees, symbolizing growth, strength, and beauty. The name Jilan represents the gentle and graceful nature of a tree, as well as the nurturing and caring qualities that are cherished in Islam.
